security_privacy_cost_impact: The runner is the catch for every thrown value on a command path: none of a thrown value's text, name, stack or cause reaches an answer or a failure report (typeof only). Errors on the wire are now limited to ones minted from a defineStableError definition (A1-261-N1). A polluted Object.prototype no longer supplies a principal (A1-261-N4). Synthetic ids only; no I/O, provider, credential, clock or randomness; no cost.
compatibility_impact: index.ts is platform-kernel's first public surface; nothing imports it yet. errorEnvelope now refuses an error not minted from a defineStableError definition (UntrustedStableErrorError); no caller outside the module exists. No contract changes.
known_limitations: Q1: a refusal before a context exists (`error`) and a failure before any correlation id (`uncorrelated`) have no CTR-API-001 wire form yet.
The runner reads no clock, so a handler that never settles is not timed out; a deadline belongs to the composition increment.
field_errors' field and code strings remain the caller's (held by review); a CTR-IDM-001 error read back from a store is not minted and must be re-minted by its owning module before replay.
The failure report port has no real adapter until CTR-OBS-001's logger (WP-1A-A6-002); adapters/** stays deferred to the provider-bound increment.
The vitest tests are not under the integrity manifest or the test-suite floor (manifest open_blockers, R7).
